state.note: Daily state sittings and two-day committee-hearing intervals are simulated scheduling cadence, not proof of actual state calendars or law. Convene and adjourn dates are recorded separately by jurisdiction. Legislative-step-pacing-and-veto-override remains an estimated game profile.

congress.note: Preserves the prior disclosed Tuesday/Thursday Congress game sittings, not the actual chamber calendars. The constitutional yearly assembly rule does not establish these weekdays.

council.note: Preserves the prior disclosed 14-day council sittings, quarterly member intake and next-day ordinary reading profile, with seven-day committee-hearing intervals for a council that refers its measures to committee. Actual local and DC sitting calendars remain research gaps. Compiled minimum reading intervals still constrain the reading date independently.
